fusions.name: Textbook Gaff
fusions.desc: A rehearsed pull-cut that deals 28 damage and always lands as a critical hit. It drags the target's guard open, leaving it 15% easier to wound for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Opening Cast
fusions.desc: Throws a barbed line that deals 4 damage to the first enemy it meets, with a 40% chance to leave it [Slowed] for 2 seconds. It has 30% more critical chance against a target that has not been hurt yet.

fusions.name: Reset the Measure
fusions.desc: Clears the cooldown on one of your other abilities, chosen at random from those still waiting, and carries you 2 tiles from where you stood.

fusions.name: Set Then Pull
fusions.desc: Every time you land a hit, a barb builds on that enemy, up to 6. Your next critical hit on it spends them all: a blow strikes it for 27% of your weapon damage per barb (163% at full). Unfed, a barb fades every 4 seconds.
